# create ec2 and attached key pare using terraform
resource "aws_instance" "web-server" {
 ami           = "ami-id" #replace you ami id
 instance_type ="t2.micro"
 key_name      ="serverkey" #replace you key name
 
 
 tags = {
   Name ="web_app"
   }
 }
 how to ganrete key
 resource "aws_key_pair" web-app" {
  key_name ="bike"
  public_key "ssh-rsa  root@terraform-server"
  
  
 #create security group and atteched to ec2 using terraform
  
   resource "aws_security_group" "my-nsg" {
    name  ="my-nsg"
	vpc_id  = aws_default_vpc.my_vpc.id  # Corrected VPC ID reference
	
	
# inbound rull = allow ssh[22]
ingress {
  from_port = 22
   to_port   = 22
  protocol  = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] #allow anyware
 }
 #outbond =allow allow
  egress {
   from_port = 0
   to_port   = 0
   protocol  = "-1"
   cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
}
}   
  
 # att to ec2 
 resource "aws_instance" "web-server" {
 ami           = "ami-id" #replace you ami id
 instance_type ="t2.micro"
 key_name      ="serverkey" #replace you key name
 vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.my-nsg.id]
 
 
 tags = {
   Name ="web_app"
   }
 }
#create custom VPC  using terraform

 resource "aws_vpc" "my-VPC"{
 cidr_block ="192.168.0.0/16"

tags = {
Name ="prod -VPC"
 }
}

# create subnet and attach to VPC using terraform 

 resource "aws_subnet" "public-subnet" {
  cidr_block = "192.168.1.0/24"
 vpc_id      = aws_vpc.my-vpc.id

tags = {
Name ="main-subnet"
 }
}

 resource "aws_subnet" "privet-subnet" {
  cidr_block = "192.168.2.0/24"
 vpc_id      = aws_vpc.my-vpc.id

tags = {
Name ="privet-subnet"
 }
}


# create route table and attached  VPC usging terraform

resource "aws_route_table "my-rt" {
vpc_id  = aws_vpc.my-VPC.id

tags = {
Name ="my-rt"
 }
}
